title: VARICOSE VEINS IMPROVE WITHOUT SURGERY — THE STEP-BY-STEP PLAN
text:

title: 15 WARNING SIGNS OF HYPOTHYROIDISM YOU CAN SEE IN THE MIRROR
text:
Dry skin, thinning hair, and cold hands are easy to blame on age, but together they can point to an underactive thyroid. This video shows seven visible signs of hypothyroidism you can check in your own mirror.

You'll see what is happening inside the body, what large studies actually found, and why the signs are only a prompt to ask about a simple TSH blood test.

What you'll learn:

－ How to do the simple swallow test to check your neck for a visible thyroid bulge

－ Why skin, hair, and nails are often the first places an underactive thyroid shows up

－ How to spot Hertoghe's sign, the fading outer third of the eyebrows, and why it is only a clue

－ The difference between ordinary morning puffiness and firm, doughy swelling around the eyes

－ What research says about feeling cold, and why a mildly high TSH in older adults needs a clinician's judgment

－ Which symptoms are emergencies, and what to ask your doctor about a TSH test

Remember: no single sign can diagnose a thyroid problem, but a pattern is worth discussing with your doctor.

title: HERE'S WHY YOUR BELLY STICKS OUT AND YOUR FACE IS SAGGING! ONE HIDDEN MUSCLE IS TO BLAME
text:

title: How Often Should Seniors Take a Shower After 60? 7 Shocking Facts You Need to Know!

title: Taking Amlodipine, Losartan, or Lisinopril for Blood Pressure? Here's What Most Seniors Don't Know!
